It turns '90 days' into 'Deep history', adds claims like 'font-perfect', 'look exactly right' and 'no questions', and is a little longer. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Neither answer says the original blurb already works. Both give several full rewrites and cut the honest Free-tier line. B is a little better because it keeps more facts intact ('$18 a month', cancelling from Settings, no email needed, fonts embedded). A drops or blurs details, such as 'Deep history', removing 'from Settings' in most versions and 'PDFs that look exactly right', and adds new claims like 'Cancel guilt-free' and 'We'd rather you stay'.
